
## Overview

Analysis of phage-bacteria lysis interactions with metadata annotations for antibiotic resistance, clonal typing, and mutation profiling.

## Load Libraries

```{r libraries}
rm(list=ls())
library(tidyverse)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(grid)
library(RColorBrewer)
```

## Parameters

```{r parameters}
# Input files
data_dir <- "../../time_kill_data"
interaction_file <- file.path(data_dir,"phage_bacteria.tsv")
metadata_file    <- file.path(data_dir,"summary_isolates.csv")
outdir           <- "./figures/"

# Visualization
ref_isolate <- "22ET500456"
show_col_names  <- TRUE
cluster_rows    <- F
cluster_cols    <- F
mlst_min_count  <- 2

# Colors
col_no_lysis    <- "#F5F5F5"
col_dim_lysis   <- "#FFEA6C"
col_clear_lysis <- "#9FA1FF"
col_na          <- "#CCCCCC"

# Create output directory
if (!dir.exists(outdir)) dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE)
```

## Read Data

```{r read_data}
# Read interaction matrix
interaction_raw <- read.delim(interaction_file, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
cat("Phages:", nrow(interaction_raw), "\nIsolates:", ncol(interaction_raw), "\n")

# Read metadata
metadata_raw <- read.csv(metadata_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
cat("Metadata records:", nrow(metadata_raw), "\n")
```

## Quality Control

```{r qc}
# Unexpected values
unexpected_vals <- setdiff(unique(as.matrix(interaction_raw)), c(1, 2, 4, NA))
if (length(unexpected_vals) > 0) {
  cat("⚠ Unexpected values:", unexpected_vals, "\n")
}

# Duplicates
dup_aliases <- metadata_raw$alias[duplicated(metadata_raw$sample)]
if (length(dup_aliases) > 0) {
  cat("⚠ Duplicated aliases:", dup_aliases, "\n")
}

# Missing metadata
isolate_names <- colnames(interaction_raw)
missing_metadata <- setdiff(isolate_names, metadata_raw$sample)
cat("Missing metadata:", length(missing_metadata), "isolates\n")
print(missing_metadata)

keep_samples <- intersect(isolate_names, metadata_raw$sample)

interaction_raw <- interaction_raw[,keep_samples]

```

## Prepare Data

```{r prepare}
# Convert to numeric matrix
hm_matrix <- t(as.matrix(interaction_raw))
class(hm_matrix) <- "numeric"

# Get lysis profile of reference isolate
ref_profile <- hm_matrix[ref_isolate, ]
  
  # Calculate Euclidean distance of all isolates to reference
distances <- apply(hm_matrix, 1, function(x) {
    sqrt(sum((x - ref_profile)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  })

# Sort by distance (most similar first)
sorted_order <- order(distances)
hm_matrix <- hm_matrix[sorted_order, ]
# ===== SORT COLUMNS (by lysis of EC45622) =====
  # Get EC45622's lysis values for each phage
  ref_lysis <- hm_matrix[ref_isolate, ]
  
  # Sort columns: 4 (clear) → 2 (dim) → 1 (no) → NA
  sorted_cols <- order(ref_lysis, decreasing = TRUE, na.last = TRUE)
  hm_matrix <- hm_matrix[, sorted_cols]
  
# Match metadata to heatmap columns
metadata <- metadata_raw %>%
  filter(sample %in% rownames(hm_matrix)) %>%
  select(sample,alias, mlst_st, MIC_ATM_AVI, BLAST_NDM, BLAST_CMY,POINT_PBP3)

metadata_ordered <- metadata %>%
  slice(match(rownames(hm_matrix), sample))

# Process annotations
mlst_st_collapsed <-metadata_ordered$mlst_st
st_counts <- table(mlst_st_collapsed)
rare_sts <- names(st_counts[st_counts < mlst_min_count])
mlst_st_collapsed[mlst_st_collapsed %in% rare_sts] <- "Other"

st_levels <- c(
  sort(as.numeric(setdiff(unique(mlst_st_collapsed), "Other"))),
  "Other"
)
st_levels <- as.character(st_levels)

mlst_st_collapsed <- factor(mlst_st_collapsed,levels=st_levels)

# Convert MIC to numeric first
mic_numeric <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("[<>]", "", metadata_ordered$MIC_ATM_AVI)))

# Categorize into MIC categories
mic_category <- sapply(mic_numeric, function(x) {
  if (is.na(x)) return("NA")
  else if (x <= 4) return("4")
  else if (x <= 8) return("8")
  else if (x <= 16) return("16")
  else if (x <= 32) return("32")
  else return("32+")
}, USE.NAMES = FALSE)

mic_category <- factor(mic_category, levels = c("4", "8", "16", "32", "32+", "NA"))
cat("  MIC distribution:\n")
print(table(mic_category))


ndm_standardized <- ifelse(metadata_ordered$BLAST_NDM == "", "Absent", "Present")
cmy_standardized <- ifelse(metadata_ordered$BLAST_CMY == "", "Absent", "Present")


cat("Processing complete. Ready to visualize.\n")
```

## Create Colors & Annotations

```{r colors_annotations}
# Color schemes
# Get sorted ST levels from factor
st_levels_sorted <- levels(mlst_st_collapsed)
st_colors <- setNames(
  colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(8, "Set2"))(length(st_levels_sorted)), 
  st_levels_sorted
)

mic_colors <- c(
  "4" = "#FDB462",      # Orange
  "8" = "#D51C39",      # Red
  "16" = "#760031",     # Darker red
  "32" = "#4A0080"    # Dark purple
)
ndm_colors <- c("Present" = "#6FCF97", "Absent" = "#F5F5F5")
cmy_colors <- c("Present" = "#4BB8FA", "Absent" = "#F5F5F5")


# Row annotations
row_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
 
  MIC_ATM_AVI =mic_category,
  BLAST_NDM = ndm_standardized,
  BLAST_CMY = cmy_standardized,
  MLST_ST = mlst_st_collapsed,
  col = list(MLST_ST = st_colors,  MIC_ATM_AVI = mic_colors,
             BLAST_NDM = ndm_colors,BLAST_CMY=cmy_colors),
  annotation_label = c( "MIC (mg/L)", "blaNDM","blaCMY","ST"),
  annotation_name_gp= gpar(fontsize = 8,fontface="bold"),
  show_legend = c(F, F, F,F),
  which = "row",
  gp = gpar(col = "#BFC6C4", lwd = 0.6))
```

## Generate Heatmap

```{r heatmap}
# Color function for main heatmap
lysis_col_func <- function(x) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), col_na,
         ifelse(x == 1, col_no_lysis,
                ifelse(x == 2, col_dim_lysis,
                       ifelse(x == 4, col_clear_lysis, col_na))))
}

# Create heatmap
hm <- Heatmap(
  hm_matrix,
  col = lysis_col_func,
  cluster_rows = F,
  cluster_columns = F,
  # Row (sample/isolate) settings - use alias names
  row_names_side = "left",
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  row_labels = metadata_ordered$alias,  # Use alias as row names
  
    # Column (phage) settings
  show_column_names = show_col_names,
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  column_names_rot = 90,  
  column_names_centered = TRUE,
  
  right_annotation = row_anno,
  
  rect_gp = gpar(col = "#BFC6C4", lwd = 0.5),
  border = TRUE,
  width = unit(ncol(hm_matrix) * 0.5, "cm"),   # Phages are columns now
  height = unit(nrow(hm_matrix) * 0.4, "cm"),  # Samples are rows now
  show_heatmap_legend = FALSE,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(legend_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7,fontface="bold"))
)

# Legend
legend_list <- packLegend(
  Legend(labels = c("No lysis", "Dim lysis", "Clear lysis"), 
         legend_gp = gpar(fill = c(col_no_lysis, col_dim_lysis, col_clear_lysis)),
         title = "Lysis Profile",title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8,fontface="bold"), labels_gp =gpar(fontsize = 8)),
         
   Legend(labels = names(mic_colors), legend_gp = gpar(fill = mic_colors), title = "MIC(mg/L)",
          title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8,fontface="bold"),labels_gp =gpar(fontsize = 8)),
   
  Legend(labels = names(ndm_colors), legend_gp = gpar(fill = ndm_colors), title = "blaNDM",
          title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8,fontface="bold"),labels_gp =gpar(fontsize = 8)),
  
  Legend(labels = names(cmy_colors), legend_gp = gpar(fill = cmy_colors), title = "blaCMY",
          title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8,fontface="bold"),labels_gp =gpar(fontsize = 8)),
  
  Legend(labels = names(st_colors), legend_gp = gpar(fill = st_colors), title = "ST", ncol = 1,
          title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8,fontface="bold"),labels_gp =gpar(fontsize = 8)),
  gap = unit(0.5, "cm")
)
```

## Display Heatmap

```{r display}

draw(hm, annotation_legend_list = legend_list, heatmap_legend_side = "right")

```

## Save Outputs

```{r save}
# PDF
pdf(file.path(outdir, "phage_bacteria_heatmap.pdf"), width = 8, height = 7)
draw(hm, annotation_legend_list = legend_list)
dev.off()
cat("✓ Saved:", file.path(outdir, "phage_bacteria_heatmap.pdf"), "\n")

# JPEG copy (300 dpi, DPI metadata embedded) for journal submission
magick::image_write(
  magick::image_read_pdf(file.path(outdir, "phage_bacteria_heatmap.pdf"), density = 300),
  path = file.path(outdir, "phage_bacteria_heatmap.jpg"), format = "jpg", quality = 95, density = "300x300"
)
cat("✓ Saved:", file.path(outdir, "phage_bacteria_heatmap.jpg"), "\n")


```
